content:
“A little goes a long way.”— Perk card description

**Chemist** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

The perk only has a single rank, which doubles the base amount of chems received from crafting.

| Rank | Description | Form ID | 
| 1 | You get double the quantity when you craft chems! | 000E36FF | 

- A second rank of the perk, which would have tripled the amounts of chems received from crafting, was cut from the game.
- Unlike in all previous games, the perk no longer boosts the duration of injected chems, this is instead done by the Chem Fiend perk.
- Antibiotics and disease cure can only be crafted while this perk is equipped.
